assembly: Actual public domain module factories, native SQLite schema/provider/executor/ID services. SQLite connection retained by fixture; fresh User Context and ID service each round.
observations: Exact before/after SQLite rows and ID space, active root, schema errors, controlled stored states and repeated rounds. No timing/log field normalization or handwritten bootstrap behavior.
scope: Seven source-compilable fixtures; three rejected shapes remain original compiler dispositions. 504 scenarios, 1008 observed rounds plus controlled warmups.
